rib_thickness = 2.0
rib_height = 20.0
num_ribs = 6

outer_radius = outer_diameter / 2.0
inner_radius = outer_radius - wall_thickness

result = Pos(0, 0, height/2) * (Cylinder(outer_radius, height) - Cylinder(inner_radius, height))

rib = Pos(inner_radius - rib_thickness/2, 0, height - rib_height/2) * Box(rib_thickness, rib_thickness, rib_height)

for i in range(num_ribs):
    angle = i * 360.0 / num_ribs
    result = result + Rot(0, 0, angle) * rib

part = result
part.name = "hollow_cylinder_with_ribs"
export_step(part, "output.step")
